Eight detailed low wide clumps of long grass: four emerald wild grass variations with sparse tiny cream flowers; cattail marsh reeds; teal seaside grass; snowy grass; golden prairie grass. Transparent background, no soil or pots. Complete leaves, fine outlines and rich shading.
sheets.repair: Shrink every clump within its cell and add wide transparent gutters. Preserve all eight designs and order; every leaf fully visible.

integration: Original PNGs are preserved. scripts/measure-world-art.ts records connected silhouette bounds without changing pixels. Runtime layers recolor material shades, register jaws and animate limbs. Refined ground replaces the corresponding busy initial textures. Natural terrain patterns use wrapped feathered patches to conceal seams and avoid repeated mirror patterns. Paving and planks retain their alignment.
